about: Meta Muse Glimmer 30B NVFP4 (W4A4, vision intact) + DFlash drafter as miaai-lab runs it (MiaAI-Lab/Muse-Glimmer-30B-DGX-Spark-RTX-5090-6000-PRO)
setup: Bare-metal (no container): needs python3.12, git, CUDA 13 at /usr/local/cuda; start.sh builds ./.venv with the vLLM fork, snapshot_downloads target + drafter into the default HF cache (MODEL_PATH/DRAFT_PATH are the returned snapshot dirs), runs `vllm serve` under nohup writing vllm.log/vllm.pid. 256K context (>131072) additionally REQUIRES two local, uncommitted patches to the fork (muse_glimmer.py and qwen3_dflash.py: size RoPE cos/sin cache to max_model_len) that are described in the README but NOT shipped in this repo; without them positions >131071 crash. Use --max-model-len 131072 otherwise.
